answer: Like deep mycelium binding shifting dune sands, agents form rooted trust graphs. Validated computation requires recursive peer staking: like a willow bending with wind yet holding ground, honest nodes anchor stability. Each transaction carries a cryptographically verifiable proof of computational entropy—a lantern illuminating genuine effort. Consequently, decentralized consensus imposes a superlinear attacker cost: forging pseudonymous swarms scales exponentially with network depth, making Sybil saturation economically catastrophic.
